phrases.latin: avia argentea ēscāria ē māchinā ēlūtōriā prōmpsit mēnsamque posuit
phrases.english: Grandma took the silver cutlery out of the dishwasher and laid the table
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 123, 305.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
